fluff.overview: Jump infantry squads are squad-strength formations equipped with personal jump packs for vertical mobility. Smaller than a full jump platoon, these squads operate as reconnaissance elements, rooftop security teams, and rapid insertion forces where a compact footprint and three-dimensional movement matter more than sustained combat power. Their reduced numbers limit staying power in prolonged engagements, but the combination of small size and jump capability makes them difficult to pin down or predict.
